## Print a total

Complete the loop to add all the values and print their total.

```{pyodide-python}
#| task: Use a loop to add all the values and print their total without using sum().
values = [3, 5, 2]
total = 0
for value in values:
    total = value  # TODO: preserve the earlier values
print(total)
```
